		*
		* Symptom: **after logging in a new account, the account list does not update on its own**; you must close the settings page and reopen it to see it.
		*
		* Root cause: the account list is **not part of the status poll (`/status`)**. The panel polls every 2 seconds, but only reads
		* `/status` and renders the **current account**; the list itself is re-read only at the few moments when
